Subject: Re: production errors from Quasar-Lite (customer-facing service)

Hi Neha —

We started seeing a spike in 5xx responses and timeouts for requests routed to Quasar-Lite (v3.0) around 08:40 PST. Error rate jumped from ~0.4% to ~6% and customers are seeing failed generation calls (timed out after 10s) intermittently. Sample request IDs attached (first column in CSV).

Impacts:
- Brightline chat assistant timeouts for multi-turn flows (primarily sequences > 400 tokens).
- Increased client-side retries causing higher latency for downstream services.

Can you confirm whether this is a known degradation and provide ETA for a mitigation? We can throttle usage on our end but need a sense of timeline.

Attachments: quasar-lite_errlog_20261203.csv (sample error IDs, stack traces), incident dashboard snapshot included.

Thanks —
Samir
Ops Lead, Brightline Health

Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 10:09:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: production errors from Quasar-Lite (customer-facing service) — triage notes

Neha / team —

Quick triage summary (initial):
- Root symptom: increased OOM/worker restart rate on the Quasar-Lite serving pool handling long-context requests (>=400 tokens). Errors manifesting as 5xx and client-observed 10s timeouts when worker processes restart under GC pressure.
- Correlation: 3.0.1 rollout included a minor quantization tweak that increases memory pressure in the 512-token path on T4-like nodes. Not all pools got the update (partial rollout), which explains why errors are bursty and regionally scoped.
- Mitigation attempted (10:02): roll back rollout -> We started gradual rollback of 3.0.1 to 3.0.0 on affected nodes; by 10:25 error rate dropped from 6% to ~0.8%.

Next steps:
1) Continue rollback to remaining affected pools (ETA 40m).
2) Add guardrail to route sequences > 400 tokens to a more memory-friendly variant (Quasar-Lite-quant-lite) as temporary fallback for Brightline only (config change) — needs Neha coordination for routing policy.
3) Postmortem to follow with root cause and permanent fix (adjust quant params and increase memory test coverage).

Logs and sample IDs attached. I’ll follow up when rollback is complete and when we flip the routing policy.

Marcus Lin
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime
[attachment: quasar-lite_errlog_20261203.csv]

Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 15:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Quasar-Lite incident: remediation completed and postmortem draft

Hi Samir / Linh —

Following up with a closure update and next steps. TL;DR: rollback to Quasar-Lite v3.0.0 completed; error rates normalized. We performed a targeted configuration change to route sequences > 400 tokens for Brightline to the quant-lite variant until a permanent patch is validated.

What happened (short):
- A partial rollout of v3.0.1 introduced a quantization tweak that increased peak memory use for long-context code paths on some T4-equivalent nodes. Under real customer load this caused worker restarts and elevated 5xx/timeouts.

Mitigation & timing:
- 10:02 12/03/2026 — rollback started for affected pools; 10:25 error rate reduced to baseline (from ~6% to ~0.8%).
- 12/03/2026 — applied customer-scoped routing rule for Brightline to route >400-token requests to Quasar-Lite-quant-lite as a temporary safeguard (no code change required).

Customer impact:
- Brightline saw increased failures for long multi-turn flows between 08:40–10:25 PST on 12/03. We estimate ~1.1k failed calls during the window.

Compensation & next steps:
- We’re preparing a postmortem doc (attached) with technical RCA and planned remediation timeline.
- As a gesture for the disruption, Redwood will provide a one-time credit applied to your next invoice equal to one week of peak token usage (we’ll coordinate with procurement if needed).
- Engineering is scheduling a follow-up: adjust quantization tests, expand canary scope for long-sequence workloads, and add a pre-rollout memory-pressure test for all T4-like pools (ETA for patch: 2 weeks).

If you want, we can set a 30-minute retrospective call next week to walk through the postmortem draft and remediation plan. Suggested times: Tue 12/08 09:00–11:00 PST or Wed 12/09 13:00–15:00 PST.

Thanks for your patience and for the quick reporting — it helped us contain the blast radius.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Account Lead — Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
